anchors.paper_title: tACS for Patients with Post-Stroke Anomia
anchors.reason: The paper title and authors match the dataset title and authors, and the abstract explicitly states it was imported from the OpenNeuro dataset ds007315.

metadata.methods_description: EEG recordings were acquired using Starstim-32 during picture naming tasks at seven timepoints (weeks 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 12, and 20). tACS was applied during alternating two-week phases with frequency and montage personalized based on initial EEG profiles. A single-case experimental design (ABAB type) was employed with 24 naming sessions and 6 EEG recording sessions per participant. EEG data were preprocessed using EEGLAB and converted to BIDS format.
